source.snippet: We use Riva Cloud Sync between Microsoft Exchange/Outlook and Salesforce Lightning. When users accept a calendar invite in Outlook (whether from shared mailboxes or external organizers), Riva marks the item in their Outlook calendar as 'Deleted by CRM' shortly afterward. The Event is NOT hard-deleted. Running SOQL queries confirms IsDeleted = false and the parent Event record remains active in Salesforce.

problem_statement: Sales and ops teams using Riva Cloud Sync to sync Outlook calendars with Salesforce lose accepted meeting events — they appear 'Deleted by CRM' in Outlook even though the Salesforce record is intact — causing missed meetings and unreliable CRM data.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and RevOps teams at mid-market B2B companies using Riva Cloud Sync with Microsoft Exchange and Salesforce Lightning.
notes: Buyer signal: organization is paying for both Salesforce and Riva Cloud Sync (two paid enterprise products). Broken calendar sync is a workflow-killing issue for sales teams. Opportunity: diagnostic/monitoring tool or managed sync audit service. Single post but describes a reproducible, business-critical pain in an enterprise paid context.
